technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with short-term bullish structure (supertrend, MACD, EMA 9/21) offset by weak trend strength (ADX 17.79), neutral momentum (RSI mid-range), and price below intermediate moving averages and Ichimoku cloud; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AON shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 14 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (344.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, CPI event just passed, and earnings binary 14 days out create compounded downside risk for AON.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technical bullish alignment (supertrend, MACD, EMA 9/21) combined with extreme market fear (34/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support (257.58) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 14 days, VIX crisis levels (344.6), price below 50/200 EMAs, weak ADX trend strength, neutral RSI momentum, and macro headwinds (rising USD, flat yield curve, recession signals) create compounded downside risk that outweighs short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term technicals (supertrend, MACD, EMA 9/21) show bullish structure and price sits at support (257.58) in extreme fear environment, but this is insufficient to offset compounded macro and earnings risks.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary in 14 days combined with VIX crisis levels (344.6), macro headwinds (rising USD, flat yield curve, recession signals), and price below 50/200 EMAs create asymmetric downside risk that negates technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals and sentiment show contrarian opportunity, but risk and fundamental agents strongly override with macro severity and earnings proximity
